sections.sectionSummaryBrief: On Shemini Atzeret specifically, the absorption of all the influences of Tishrei occurs, reaching the essential concealment, which is exclusively for Israel alone with the King.

translations.translation: And this is why specifically on Shemini Atzeret it is said, “It shall be a solemn assembly for you”
(even though all the festivals and holy days were given specifically to Israel),
for since on Shemini Atzeret is the absorption of all the influences of the month of Tishrei,
Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, etc.,
the matter of teshuvah that reaches
(as above)
to the level of concealment that is not in existence,
until the level of the essential concealment,
behold, this matter is specifically “for you,” “they shall be yours alone, and not for strangers with you,”
Israel and the King alone.
And this is also the reason for establishing Simchat Torah specifically on Shemini Atzeret,
because on Shemini Atzeret is the absorption of all the influences of the month of Tishrei that are drawn through teshuvah,
including also the matter of the Second Tablets that were given on Yom Kippur,
and the joy of Simchat Torah is over the Second Tablets, as above
(section 5).

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The joy of Simchat Torah is specifically in the letters of the Torah, through which the Essence is drawn and Israel becomes one with the Awtsmoos.

translations.translation: And this is that the joy of Simchat Torah is in the letters of the Torah
[and as above
(at the beginning of the maamar),
that the manner of joy is that they encircle the reading table with the Torah scroll, where they read
(throughout the year)
in the letters of the Torah],
because the revelation through the letters of the Torah
[letters from the term “ata boker” (the morning has come)]
is above comprehension and intellect,
and as explained elsewhere regarding “Anochi” being an acronym for “Ana Nafshi Ketavit Yahavit,”
that this—that the Holy One, blessed be He, dictated and gave His very Essence
(Ana Nafshi)
in the Torah—
is primarily in the letters of the Torah,
and because on the Atzeret of the festival is the absorption of the matters drawn through teshuvah,
the distant becoming near,
through which is drawn from the level of a distant place, a concealment that is not in existence, until the essential concealment of His Essence,
and the drawing is in a manner that Israel becomes one with His Essence,
Israel and the King alone,
therefore the joy then is specifically in the letters of the Torah,
because the drawing of the Essence is primarily in the letters of the Torah
(as above),
and through them Israel becomes one with the Essence.
And as explained in the maamar,
that each and every Jew has a letter in the Torah,
that this letter gives him vitality,
and also protects him from all undesirable matters,
and it is also a channel and vessel for the blessing of Havayah for everything he needs,
beginning with the matter of the absorption
(on Shemini Atzeret)
of all the influences drawn for him in the month of Tishrei,
“the letters of Rosh” (initial letters),
for the entire year.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: From the joy of Simchat Torah, strength is drawn for the journey of “Yaakov went on his way,” ensuring all resolutions are fulfilled with joy and bringing blessing and the true redemption.

translations.translation: And from the joy of Simchat Torah,
“we will all become one festival and rejoice,”
there is drawn empowerment for the journey of “and Yaakov went on his way,”
also in the journey of the winter days, which is a difficult journey as above,
that they actually fulfill all the resolutions they make on Simchat Torah,
for since the resolutions are with joy, joy is above all the attributes and breaks all boundaries,
so that they pay no attention to any obstacles or delays and fulfill all the resolutions with strength.
And since the joy is in the letters of the Torah, which are the channel and vessel for the blessing of Havayah for everything needed
(as above),
behold, through this there is drawn an addition of the greatest blessing and success in all matters throughout the entire year,
and particularly in the essential matter,
that it be a year of redemption,
the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,
speedily in our days, literally.
